column4: Subscriptions don't remind you. They renew.
A bank shows what you paid. Keeping Tabs on Subs shows what you can still stop.
Add a subscription in one step. Just type a sentence.
Or paste a screenshot of the receipt email.
The AI reads it and proposes an entry. It never guesses. Anything missing becomes a short question.
Already tracking it? It proposes an update, and shows you the price change.
Nothing is added until you approve it.
Your list is sorted by what to act on first, with the date to cancel by.
Trials, price rises, missing dates and ending plans are all flagged.
Reminders arrive three, one and zero days before the deadline. One tap to keep it, or mark it cancelled, with the proof logged.
It's hosted in the EU, invite-only, and the AI only sees the capture you hand it.
Keeping Tabs on Subs. Know what renews, and cancel in time.
